channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Scottie Pippen | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Scottie Pippen from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Draymond Green on LeBron James, Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“You remember the day and age where Michael Jordan was celebrated, not ridiculed like LeBron James. The coverage of basketball as a whole was completely different. I grew up in that era, and now, being one of the players, and seeing that that's not a thing at all, nowadays, we want to talk about, I can't remember a single time where someone said, 'Man, Scottie Pippen need to win this game or his legacy is tarnished.'”

Draymond Green on LeBron James, Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen, Sep 21, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Kwame Brown on Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen
item.description:
Kwame Brown:

“Stackhouse one day told (Michael Jordan), I didn't come here to be your Scottie Pippen. He thought that he was going to be the number one option and then MJ would be backing him up, but he found out very quickly that that wasn't the case and MJ was the number one option and Stack had to get in where he fit in.”

Kwame Brown on Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen, Sep 21, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Kawhi Leonard on Scottie Pippen
item.description:
Kawhi Leonard:

“I'm not here to take over anything… I want to help Scottie. If it’s Scottie’s team, it’s his team.”

Kawhi Leonard on Scottie Pippen, Sep 16, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Gary Payton on Scottie Pippen, Shawn Kemp, Austin Reaves
item.description:
said Gary Payton in a one-on-one interview about the Lakers.

“Same thing with the Chicago Bulls (back in the 90s), you're building around Luka, that's what you're building around. Reaves is going to be your Scottie Pippen, so it's just like with us, with Seattle, it's me and Sean Kemp, it's Luka and Reeves. They're building around their guys, and they're trying to put people around these dudes that is going to do their job, get a rebound, make a big-time shot, and then let these guys be Batman and Robin.”

Gary Payton on Scottie Pippen, Shawn Kemp, Austin Reaves, Jul 14, 2026. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Tim Hardaway on Scottie Pippen, Dennis Rodman, Luc Longley
item.description:
“I’m talking about one-on-one, if it was one-on-one, he would get cooked. Cuz ain’t nobody there. Scottie Pippen ain’t coming there to block your shot. Luc Longley… he not coming over there and put his big body on you, and he would hurt you, too…Dennis Rodman, he ain’t coming there to take the charge,”

Tim Hardaway on Scottie Pippen, Dennis Rodman, Luc Longley, Mar 5, 2026. Source: Basketball Network.

item.title: Dominique Wilkins on Scottie Pippen, Jalen Johnson
item.description:
Wilkins told Casino.org in an exclusive interview.

“Pippen was a point forward, and was very effective at the position. This guy Jalen, he brings even another element, because the way he rebounds, the way he passes, and he flirts with a triple-double every single night. I love Jalen Johnson. The way he plays, man, and he’s so deserving of this honor that he received during All-Star weekend. I couldn’t be happier for him.”

Dominique Wilkins on Scottie Pippen, Jalen Johnson, Feb 26, 2026. Source: casino.org.

item.title: Dominique Wilkins on Scottie Pippen
item.description:
Dominique Wilkins, who matched up against Chicago Bulls great Scottie Pippen during their heyday, compared Jalen Johnson to the six-time NBA champion.

“Well, I must say he’s a little bit of Scottie Pippen as far as being a point forward,”

Dominique Wilkins on Scottie Pippen, Feb 26, 2026. Source: casino.org.

item.title: Klay Thompson on Tony Parker, Manu Ginobili, Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen, Magic Johnson, Tim Duncan, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar
item.description:
Thompson:

“That’s one of the greatest partnerships ever. You can compare it to peanut butter and jelly. They’re one of the greatest duos of all time. No question about it. They won four championships together. You have to win championships together to be compared to Scottie Pippen and Michael Jordan or to Magic Johnson and Kareem Abdul-Jabbar or Tim Duncan and Manu Ginobili and Tony Parker. They are definitely in that category or that conversation.”

Klay Thompson on Tony Parker, Manu Ginobili, Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen, Magic Johnson, Tim Duncan, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Nov 12, 2024. Source: SportsKeeda.

item.title: Klay Thompson on Scottie Pippen
item.description:
“I grew up in Portland, so I remember when Scottie Pippen came to the Blazers, that was one of the best days of my life.”

Klay Thompson on Scottie Pippen, Jul 9, 2024. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen
item.description:
Shaq said on The Big Podcast.

“I would have played with Mike (Jordan) and Scottie (Pippen) and then I would have left them and played in my hometown San Antonio with the Spurs. But, nah, I was like, nope. I want to beat all these guys.”

Shaquille O'Neal on Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen, Feb 28, 2024. Source: Fade Away World.

item.title: Tracy McGrady on Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen, Magic Johnson, Larry Bird
item.description:
Tracy McGrady:

“You look at some of the greats that have come through this game. And I'm not saying Magic Johnson was lucky, but Magic Johnson played with a lot of freaking Hall of Famers. I'm not saying Larry Bird was lucky either. He played with a lot of Hall of Famers as well. Jordan wasn't so lucky of playing with a lot of Hall of Famers. He just had a great sidekick in Scottie Pippen. But if you look at Jordan before Scottie Pippen became Scottie Pippen, Jordan was just a great individual player. Like,Jordan wasn't getting out of the first round or going deep into the playoffs before Scottie Pippen became Scottie Pippen.”

Tracy McGrady on Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen, Magic Johnson, Larry Bird, Jul 26, 2023. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Bill Walton on Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen
item.description:
Brandon Scoop B Robinson: Scottie Pippen's beef with Michael Jordan is surprising to Bill Walton:

“I’m shocked and dismayed and those words are NOT strong enough to relate my feelings as the way that Scottie Pippen treats Michael Jordan.”

Bill Walton on Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen, Jun 15, 2023. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Mychal Thompson on Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen, Bill Russell
item.description:
“I can guarantee you they’re probably thinking, ‘Man, if we could only match with Michael Jordan and Scottie Pippen, that would be great.’ Now forget about Bill Russell. Nobody’s ever going to get to 11,”

Mychal Thompson on Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen, Bill Russell, Jul 23, 2022. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Jerry Reinsdorf on Scottie Pippen, Jerry Krause
item.description:
“We had won five championships at that point, and Krause came to me and said: ‘Look, I'm not sure I can guarantee — I don't know how strong I feel about winning a sixth championship. ButI have a chance to trade Scottie Pippen to the Boston Celtics for two very high picks (No. 3 and 6 in the 1997 draft),’”

Jerry Reinsdorf on Scottie Pippen, Jerry Krause, Mar 19, 2022. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Charles Oakley on Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen
item.description:
During Simmons’ podcast, Oakley continued:

“[Jordan] always praised Scottie, always praised Scottie. He never talked down about him, but I don’t know what happened since ‘The Last Dance.’ It seems like things just — he probably said,‘OK, Scottie said this stuff about me. OK, I’m not gonna say nothing.’ He’s not gonna say nothing back in the press, none of that, try to go back to Scottie. He’s just gonna keep doing what he’s doing — play golf, fish, relax and smoke cigars.”

Charles Oakley on Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen, Jan 28, 2022. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Charles Oakley on Steve Kerr, Scottie Pippen, Dennis Rodman
item.description:
“I think they [covered] Dennis Rodman more than Scottie — and Steve Kerr in ‘The Last Dance,'”

Charles Oakley on Steve Kerr, Scottie Pippen, Dennis Rodman, Jan 28, 2022. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Charles Oakley on Scottie Pippen
item.description:
Oakley explained to Betway.

“We don't know, but one day we will find out. I don't think Scottie would just turn [to] all this from ‘The Last Dance.’ Some stuff happened 10-20 years ago, but now he’s got a platform to talk about it. But he did say he wants to have his last say about ‘The Last Dance,’ so who knows what's going on?”

Charles Oakley on Scottie Pippen, Dec 2, 2021. Source: basketballnews.com.

item.title: Charles Oakley on Scottie Pippen
item.description:
Charles Oakley:

“Scottie felt like he was mistreated, and he didn't look good. Scottie did some things that we talked about. I’m friends with Scottie and Mike, but I don't talk about Mike to Scottie, or Scottie to Mike.”

Charles Oakley on Scottie Pippen, Dec 1, 2021. Source: Betway.com.

item.title: Toni Kukoc on Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen
item.description:
The fact he accepted a bench role for the Bulls’ second three-peat teams, winning the NBA’s Sixth Man of the Year award in 1996, when his talent would have led him to starting — and starring — on lesser teams is also noteworthy.

“The first time I met Michael (Jordan) and Scottie (Pippen) was at the ‘92 Olympics in Barcelona and it wasn’t the greatest experience for me. And according to the first game, they were probably going, ‘Oh my gosh, do we really need him?’”

Toni Kukoc on Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen, May 16, 2021. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Toni Kukoc on Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen
item.description:
Toni Kukoc:

“The only way to play with Michael and Scottie and Phil is they force you to practice hard to play hard, to give your max every single day just for those moments. So when those moments happen, I don’t want to say it’s expected. But in a way, it is. And you’re ready to perform.”

Toni Kukoc on Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen, May 16, 2021. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Shawn Kemp on Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen
item.description:
“And I look at Michael Jordan, he played with the Bulls, and he had Scottie Pippen. But without Michael being there, the Bulls wasn’t gonna win the championship. It came from Michael Jordan.”

Shawn Kemp on Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen, Nov 6, 2020. Source: Fade Away World.

item.title: Bill Cartwright on Scottie Pippen
item.description:
Cartwright:

“It’s interesting that when the play when Pip did not come back in the game, that was Pip’s best year. He had evolved into a leadership role, played great. To me, people make mistakes and then you move on from them. I think Scottie has a big heart. And when I first got to the Bulls he wasn’t a great shooter, skinny, extraordinarily talented, so everything he had he worked for. For me Pip was a great teammate and like I said it was one man’s show and that’s what they saw. But that’s not really reality.”

Bill Cartwright on Scottie Pippen, May 20, 2020. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Craig Hodges on Scottie Pippen
item.description:
Hodges:

“I’m still kind of upset about it because I know the type of brother that Scottie is. Scottie is the type of brother, I wasn’t part of the team when he didn’t stand up and come back out and play during that play, but I know that Scottie is the type of cat that will give his shirt for you, go on the ground for you and kick out the shot for you. I didn’t like how he was portrayed and I don’t understand the reasoning behind it and I’m still trying to figure that out. Without Scottie, MJ would not have won. It’s like all the brothers sitting here. It’s almost like MJ won in a vacuum and it wasn’t anything like that. To throw your brother, especially no. 33, under the bus, that wasn’t cool.”

Craig Hodges on Scottie Pippen, May 20, 2020. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Dennis Rodman on Scottie Pippen
item.description:
“He was great, but he couldn't play multiple positions like Scottie could. He wasn't agile enough. I just don't think people realize what Scottie was doing in 1991.”

Dennis Rodman on Scottie Pippen, May 8, 2020. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Michael Jordan on Scottie Pippen, Horace Grant
item.description:
“I don't think that statement needs to be corrected because I said it in jest on a bus with Horace Grant and Scottie Pippen,”

Michael Jordan on Scottie Pippen, Horace Grant, May 4, 2020. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Toni Kukoc on Scottie Pippen
item.description:
“My difference is I was getting into the world champion Chicago Bulls. Everybody is great. Everybody knows what needs to be done. It wasn’t easy. ButI can honestly say, regardless of what Scottie said before, he was a huge help to me, especially that first year. He was absolutely awesome towards me.”

Toni Kukoc on Scottie Pippen, Apr 24, 2020. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Robert Parish on Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen
item.description:
Appearing on the Locked On Celtics podcast, Parish described a practice where his second unit held its own against Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen, and the starters.

“I was talking trash to Michael because he and Scottie was enjoying their dominance over the second team, and then when the second team finally got a center that could enhance their abilities, the first team could no longer enjoy dominance over the second team,”

Robert Parish on Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen, Apr 22, 2020. Source: Booth Newspapers.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Scottie Pippen
item.description:
“Asked whether there was resentment from other Bulls players over Pippen's decision, Kerr said, ‘No, not at all.’“Everyone respected Scottie so much,”

Steve Kerr on Scottie Pippen, Apr 22, 2020. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Dennis Rodman on Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen
item.description:
“If you notice about Scottie Pippen, when Michael Jordan left in ’93, ’94, ’95 — Scottie Pippen was the best player in the world,”

Dennis Rodman on Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen, Apr 20, 2020. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen, Larry Krystkowiak
item.description:
KC Johnson:Steve Kerr:

“Can anybody tell me who scored the first basket in United Center history? You think Pippen or Jordan. It’s Larry Krystkowiak.”

Steve Kerr on Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen, Larry Krystkowiak, Mar 2, 2017. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.
